class.name: Shaman
class.text: Totems, shocks and a weapon you imbue. Lightning Bolt and Healing Wave are yours from the start, Earth Shock comes at 4 and Lightning Shield at 8. At 10 a Fire totem and Flame Shock join, and Ghost Wolf follows at 20. Every line below says what to drop, what to press and when to stop and drink.

card.caresAbout: mana, which totems are down, the shock that is ready, and what is on your weapon
card.vocabulary: drop, totem, shock, imbue, shield, bolt, strike, wolf, drink
card.soundsLike: practical and a little dry, a trainer who points at the ground where the totem goes. A shaman line says what to drop or press, then what it buys
card.neverSays: rage, holy, anything about gods, spirits or ancestors, and none of the class's lore
card.test: could it be said while the totem is still in your hand?

advice.say: Enhancement is the build this page advises, because it is the smoothest to level and its Stormstrike comes at 25. The price: you fight up close and your mana is thin until 30. Elemental stays at range with bolts and shocks, and it is slower alone because you drink more.
Restoration is the healer. It is the right pick for dungeons and for playing with a friend. Alone it is the slowest way to level, and a damage build with a good weapon is quicker.

overview.who: You drop totems, imbue your weapon, shock what stands in front of you and heal yourself when it hurts. The craft is mana: nearly everything you do costs it, and the rest of the class is ways to get it back.
overview.good: Doing a bit of everything. You can fight up close or from range, heal yourself or a friend, interrupt a cast with Earth Shock and cross the world as a wolf from 20.
overview.bad: Mana. A long fight runs you dry, a pack can overwhelm you, and your best talents come late. Totems cost mana too, so drop only what the fight needs.
overview.resource: Mana. It returns slowly after five seconds of not casting, so finish a nearly dead monster with the weapon. Mindfulness, Water Shield and Improved Stormstrike let it return while you fight.
overview.levelling: Imbue your weapon, drop the Fire totem and open with a shock. Keep Earth Shock for casters, heal after the fight and drink before the next. Enhancement is the quickest to level, and Elemental and Restoration are slower alone.
overview.ten: You get your first talent point and pick a spec. Enhancement is the smoothest to level, Elemental stays at range and Restoration heals a group. Your Fire totem quest is at 10 too, and a respec costs gold.

damage.reason: Most guides level Enhancement. Stormstrike comes at 25, Windfury Weapon at 30, and it needs less drinking than Elemental.

heal.reason: The healer for dungeons and for playing with a friend. Riptide and Chain Heal come at 40, and Water Shield at 20 carries your mana.

builds.name: Elemental
builds.intro: Elemental opens with a shock and a bolt from a distance, and Lightning Overload and Lightning Mastery make the bolts hit twice and hit fast. It is slower to level than Enhancement because you stop to drink more often.
builds.line: Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Flame Shock from range. Strong in a group, slow alone, and hungry for mana.
builds.pathNote: (31 points in Elemental, 11 in Restoration for mana, 9 in Enhancement.)
builds.split: how early to take the mana. Tiqqle's second order starts with Tidal Focus, Mindfulness and Water Shield and gives up damage until level 21. The order here is the first one, which waits for Water Shield until 43.
builds.dry: Your mana is the slowest part of the fight, so finish a nearly dead monster with the weapon.

path.why: Shocks, Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning cost 2% less a point. Mana is what stops a caster, so it comes first.
Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning cast faster. Lightning Overload needs it, and a faster cast is less time under a monster's claws.
More damage on Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Earth Shock, the spells you cast most.
A damage spell can make your next one free. Spend the free cast on the dearest spell you have.
Concussion at full strength: more damage on Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Earth Shock.
Your fire totems and Flame Shock hit harder, and Flame Shock lasts longer.
Being hit while you cast has a good chance of not slowing Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning. Fewer ruined casts.
Flame Shock lasts longer and Searing Totem hurts more, so more of the work is done while you rest.
Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning can cast a second time for free, at half damage. Elemental Fury needs it.
Spells hit 5% more often, which a caster wants too. These points open Mindfulness and Water Shield.
Some of your mana regeneration keeps going while you cast. You drink less, and the fight does not stop for it.
Totems cost less mana. The points are on the way to Water Shield, which asks for ten in the tree.
Globes of water give back mana when you are hit or land a critical strike. You give up Lightning Shield for it, since only one shield holds.
Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning get 5% more critical strike chance.
Earthbind Totem roots nearby monsters for 5 seconds when you drop it. A pack stops and you keep casting.
Critical hits from your fire, frost and nature spells do far more damage. It needs Lightning Overload.
Your burst: for 15 seconds Chain Lightning has no cooldown and Lightning Bolt casts faster. Press it on a hard pull.
Intellect: more mana, and more spell critical chance. Nothing left in the Elemental tree helps you more.
More critical strikes on every spell and attack. It is the best that is left.

builds.name: Enhancement
builds.intro: Enhancement fights up close with a weapon, shocks and Stormstrike. Most guides call it the smoothest Shaman to level. Mana is its trouble before 30, so the first talents are about mana and Stormstrike.
builds.line: Stormstrike, shocks and a weapon imbue, up close. The smoothest Shaman to level, once Stormstrike is yours at 25.
builds.pathNote: (34 points in Enhancement, 11 in Restoration for mana, 6 in Elemental.)
builds.split: mana against speed. Icy Veins would start in Restoration for Mindfulness and Water Shield and respec at 25. Nicktew calls that a mistake, because Stormstrike should come as early as it can. The order here is Nicktew's, with Mindfulness and Water Shield after Improved Stormstrike.
builds.dry: The weapon matters more than any talent, so keep a slow two-hander in your hand.

path.why: A point is 1% more critical strikes on every attack and spell. It is the only talent on that row that helps a fighter on every swing.
Turns your Intellect into attack power, and Intellect is also your mana. Gear with it pays twice. Flurry needs it.
Intellect is a bigger mana pool and now attack power too. These two points open the third row, and nothing on row 2 helps you more.
Shocks and Lightning Shield cost 45% less mana. Mana is what stops you, and Earth Shock is a button you press all the time.
Your weapon imbues hit harder: Rockbiter and Windfury Weapon give more, Flametongue does more damage.
One point to open the next row, and a little dodge. Ancestral Knowledge works as well if you would sooner have mana.
Your main button. A weapon strike on a short cooldown that makes your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or Earth Shock hit harder.
Ghost Wolf becomes instant and works indoors. From level 20 it is how you cross the world.
More attack speed after a critical strike. It needs Mental Dexterity, and it opens the row that holds Improved Stormstrike.
Stormstrike can give you mana regeneration while you cast, and a dodge or a parry can reset its cooldown. It keeps you fighting.
You can parry, and a parry can reset Stormstrike. It also makes less threat while Rockbiter Weapon is off, which a group likes.
Healing costs 5% less and you hit 5% more often. The hit helps a fighter too, and these points open Mindfulness and Water Shield.
Some of your mana regeneration keeps going while you cast. Mana is what stops a shaman, so it is worth a detour out of your tree.
Totems cost less mana. It is the least bad pick on its row, and Water Shield asks for ten points in the tree.
Globes of water give back mana when you are hit or land a critical strike. You give up Lightning Shield for it, since only one shield holds.
A third point of attack speed after a critical strike.
Adds spell damage from your Intellect. It is small for you, but Rage of the Farseer asks for it.
Melee hits can stack a quicker, cheaper Lightning Bolt up to 5 times. Cast the bolt at 5 stacks.
Your own small bloodlust: 30% attack speed for 25 seconds, on a long cooldown. Press it on a hard pull.
Attack speed after a critical strike, at its full strength.
More damage on Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Earth Shock. It is the only damage left that fits.
A critical spell hit raises your melee critical chance for a short while, so your bolts and shocks feed Flurry.

builds.name: Restoration
builds.intro: Restoration heals a group with Healing Wave, Riptide and Chain Heal, and fills the gaps with totems. It is for dungeons and for playing with a friend. Alone it is the slowest way to level.
builds.line: Healing Wave, Riptide and Chain Heal, with totems. A healer for a group, slow alone.
builds.pathNote: (46 points in Restoration, 5 in Enhancement for Intellect.)
builds.split: when to take the mana talents. Devil's order, the newest, takes Mindfulness at 15 and Water Shield at 20. Tiqqle and Nicktew take them later in their damage orders. The order here is Devil's.
builds.dry: A heal that lands early beats a bigger heal that lands late.

path.why: Healing Wave casts faster. It is the heal you cast most, and a quicker cast lands before the damage does.
Some of your mana regeneration keeps going while you cast. A healer casts all the time, so this keeps you healing.
Healing costs 5% less at full ranks, and spells hit more often. These points lead to Water Shield.
Globes of water give back mana when you are hit or land a critical strike. Only one shield holds, so it replaces Lightning Shield.
Tidal Focus at full strength: healing costs 5% less and you hit more often with spells.
A critical heal gives your target more armour for a while. One point opens the way to Mana Tide Totem.
Mana Tide Totem gives your whole group mana back, on a long cooldown. Press it when the group runs low.
Being hit while you cast has a good chance of not slowing your heals. Fewer ruined casts.
A critical heal gives your target more armour for a while. It takes the points Nature's Swiftness asks for.
Your next Nature spell, Healing Wave among them, becomes instant. It is the emergency button.
Healing Wave heals for much more. It is the spell you cast most, and Riptide needs this talent.
A critical heal gives your target more armour for a while. It is the last point of a row you had to pass.
Every healing spell heals 10% more. It is the biggest plain gain on the tree.
A heal over time that makes Chain Heal stronger on the same target. Put it on the hurt, then Chain Heal them.
Your healing spells crit more often, and a crit gives back mana through Water Shield.
Totems cost less mana at full ranks. You drop several in a dungeon.
Mana Spring Totem and Healing Stream Totem work 5% better a point. It helps the whole group.
Intellect: more mana to heal with, and more spell critical chance. Nothing left in Restoration helps you more.

stages.about: Riptide and Chain Heal at 40 are your group healing: put Riptide on the hurt, then Chain Heal that target. Healing Way and Purification make every heal count. Keep your group close so Chain Heal can jump.

opening.name: Water Shield
opening.if: if you took it, before each pull
opening.why: it gives back mana when you are hit or crit

opening.name: Lightning Shield
opening.if: if you did not take Water Shield
opening.why: its orbs hurt whatever hits you

opening.name: Mana Spring Totem
opening.if: when your group needs the mana
opening.why: it gives mana back to you and your party

opening.name: Riptide
opening.if: on the tank, before the pull
opening.why: it heals over time and powers up Chain Heal

loop.name: Riptide
loop.if: on a hurt ally who does not have it
loop.why: it heals over time and powers up Chain Heal

loop.name: Chain Heal
loop.if: when two or more are hurt
loop.why: it jumps on, and hits harder on a Riptide target

loop.name: Lesser Healing Wave
loop.if: when a big hit would land too late
loop.why: it is quicker than Healing Wave but heals less for its mana

loop.name: Healing Wave
loop.why: it is your efficient heal

loop.name: Earth Shock
loop.why: it stops the cast before you must heal it

loop.name: Lightning Bolt
loop.why: damage from range while the group is healthy

rarely.name: Tremor Totem
rarely.why: it breaks fear, charm and sleep

rarely.name: Healing Stream Totem
rarely.why: it heals a little all the time

rarely.name: Fire Nova
rarely.if: against three or more, if nobody is hurt
rarely.why: it adds damage for little mana

between.if: after a fight, before the next pull
between.why: mana from drinking is cheap, and a pull on empty is not

between.why: it gives back part of their mana
